# Team decisions conclude without stalling or being escalated to the product owner

- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (the team's Decider aligned with the original Core Protocols decider, also in mob-defaults)
- **Source:** the product owner's ruling of 2026-11-07 after card 313's task-force vote ran more than two hours over many rounds with no code: align the team's Decider with the original protocol (the McCarthys' Core Protocols, summarised at https://darkcoding.net/behaviour/decider-protocol/). Decider D194 recorded the card 313 proposal as failed after an outlier kept raising new demands and another seat's condition conflicted with it.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Steve, I want team decisions to conclude without stalling or being escalated to me, so that cards reach users sooner and I am asked only the questions that are really about purpose or direction.
- **One user-observable outcome:** Steve reads a decision record where every outlier's precise condition was either met or the proposal died, and sees no escalation of an impasse.
- **Acceptance criteria (Gherkin; ZOMBIES letter in each title):**
  1. Scenario: [Z] [E] unresolved outliers kill the proposal. Given a vote whose outliers cannot be brought in after one amendment, When the round ends, Then the proposal is recorded as failed, the impasse is not escalated, and a new proposal is made and voted as a fresh Decider.
  2. Scenario: [O] the outlier's promise. Given one outlier asked "what will it take to get you to endorse the proposal?", When it states precisely what it requires, Then the record holds that one condition and the seat's promise to support the proposal once it is met.
  3. Scenario: [M] a new demand breaks the promise. Given a seat whose stated condition was adopted, When it raises a different demand in a later round, Then the later demand is not adopted and the record names the broken promise.
  4. Scenario: [B] too many objections. Given a vote in which No plus Support-it votes are more than about 30 percent of the seats, When the round ends, Then the proposer drops the proposal and the record says so.
  5. Scenario: [E] an absolute No. Given a seat declares an absolute No (no condition would change it), When the round ends, Then the proposal is dead and that seat makes the next proposal.
  6. Scenario: [I] minor amendments get a quick check. Given a minor amendment to a voted proposal, When the amendment is folded in, Then the other voters get a quick check and any of them may demand a formal re-vote; this is consistent with story 319.
  7. Scenario: [S] the same text is in mob-defaults. Given the mob-defaults Decider text, When a new mob is created, Then it carries these rules, written timeless with no dates or personal names.
- **Zombies note:** every letter Z, O, M, B, I, E and S is tagged above.
- **Not in this card:** a purpose or direction question still goes to the product owner; the story 319 diff review; dropping the independent re-run (F-038) unless the team decides it separately.

## Context

- Filed by the facilitator on 2026-11-07 from the product owner's inbox ruling.
